warning_signs: Small dark spots appear on older leaves
Leaves gradually turn yellow and fall
Early Blight.advice: Remove severely affected leaves and avoid keeping the foliage wet for long periods.
Early Blight.treatment: Remove infected plant material and improve air circulation. Use a fungicide only when necessary and according to the product label.
Early Blight.application: Follow the locally approved product label for crop, dose, spray interval, and pre-harvest interval.
Early Blight.safety_note: Use only products approved for tomato and the diagnosed disease. Follow the label and use appropriate protective equipment.

warning_signs: Dark water-soaked patches appear on leaves
Brown or black lesions may spread quickly
Fruit may develop dark firm patches
Late Blight.advice: Remove affected plant material and improve air circulation around plants.
Late Blight.treatment: Remove severely affected material and use an appropriately approved fungicide when required.
Late Blight.application: Follow the locally approved product label for dose, spray interval, and pre-harvest interval.
Late Blight.safety_note: Use only products approved for tomato and late blight. Follow the label and wear appropriate protective equipment.
